name: Early Bird Frühstückscafé
kurzbeschreibung:
**Wake-Up Call Café** – Your **Tirol** Breakfast Haven

Start your day with a hearty **Frühstück** at **Wake-Up Call Café**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Whether you crave a fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn**, a crispy **Speckknödel**, or a fresh **Apfelstrudel**, our menu has something to satisfy every palate. Pair your meal with a steaming **Kaffee** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** for the perfect morning boost.

Just a short stroll from **Innsbruck**, we offer a cozy retreat where locals and travelers alike can enjoy authentic **Tiroler** flavors in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Come early—our **Frühstück** is served until **11:00 AM**, and seats fill fast!

**Willkommen in Tirol!** ☕🍳
